answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch, three auditors re-check one job: a timber delivery must match its supplier receipt. A garden trellis job must match its record, and a coastal shipment its tide log, so one receipt cannot serve many identities. Failure forfeits a 40-unit bond and suspension. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 units, before faking records. An honest agent pays one bond and earns undiluted rewards.
